free_tier.stated: Free to use, with no key and no request limit stated on the home page, the docs or the README: COVID-19 and influenza statistics as JSON.
free_tier.notes: A burst of 120 parallel keyless GETs all answered HTTP 200. The Worldometers totals update every 10 minutes.

per_object_cap.stated: no cap stated; one GET of /v3/covid-19/historical?lastdays=all returned the whole JHU time series of every country and province in 13953048 bytes

retention.stated: the JHU time series runs from 1/22/20 to 3/9/23; the Worldometers totals are live, updated every 10 minutes

egress.terms: not applicable: JSON answers, not metered in bytes

interface_detail: HTTPS GET at disease.sh/v3/ with JSON answers, open to all origins (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *); the OpenAPI 3.0.0 document is at disease.sh/apidocs/swagger_v3.json and the live reference at disease.sh/docs/
tooling: any HTTP client. The last resort is self-hosted: the open-source API server, which the user installs and runs with Redis on a rented or free machine, started with docker-compose or npm.
chaining: Free keyless epidemiology numbers for dashboards: live Worldometers totals by country and continent, with the JHU time series for history up to 3/9/23. Bulk path: GET /v3/covid-19/historical?lastdays=all returns the whole time series of every country and province in one JSON of 13953048 bytes; the JHU CSSE and NYT repositories that the README lists as sources are the public bulk data behind it. The last resort is self-hosted: the open-source server that the user installs and runs with Redis on a rented or free machine.

limits.value: no limit stated; 120 parallel keyless GETs in one burst all answered HTTP 200, with no 429

binding_note: No quota, key or rate limit is stated, and a 120-request parallel burst met no 429; what a reader meets instead is a feed that has stopped updating or fails.

identity_cost.detail: No account and no key: the home page states that no signup is required, and keyless GETs answered HTTP 200.

reliability_note: On 2026-11-02 /v3/covid-19/jhucsse/counties answered HTTP 502 with Retry-After 60, and the JHU time series ends on 3/9/23; the live Worldometers totals answered 200 with JSON that carries an updated timestamp.
confidence_note: Free use and no sign-up are stated on the home page and in the site source; keyless GETs answered 200, one request returned the whole JHU series, and 120 parallel GETs met no 429. No rate limit is published, so the absence of one is read from that burst and not from a statement.
